panels.description: In a rented Halyard workroom, four components surround a cloudy Keel water sample while Alex stands with the collaborators. Keep the upper worktable clear.
Lina tests the cloudy sample and rejects a membrane. Keep the upper test apparatus clear.
The collaborators connect the remaining components; incompatible interfaces fail to communicate. Keep the upper apparatus clear.
The prototype readout drops to eleven percent simulated efficiency as vapor escapes. Keep the upper readout clear.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Keel has water now. It can’t use it.

items.speaker: LINA
items.text: Not that one. It lies under heat.

items.speaker: REN
items.text: Good. Now we know where it breaks.
